the development of a recirculating aquaponic system in Saudi Arabia that is capable of year round intensive food and feed production with a minimum water consumption and maximum reuse of water and fish effluents.
the design, operation, and management of aquaponic systems for maximizing water reuse, food production, and energy efficiency.
the development of aquaponic systems that are economically and environmentally sound.

a recirculating aquaponic system is a sustainable system for food production and water conservation in Saudi Arabia.

an indoor aquaponic setup could be operated for intensive fish production and hydroponic lettuce at a fish feed to plants ratio of 56:1.
a recirculating system could be designed for a sustainable food production in Saudi Arabia.
